description:
Title: Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine

You develop an application that helps you with the inspection of a machine.
After entering the type of the machine, and its serial number, the inspection can begin:
* Questions are asked, and you have to input values.
* Buttons are to be pressed, and values are automatically collected from the machine and shown to you.
* Depending on the results, additional questions are asked (or not).
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_MachineInspection" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/machine-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MachineInspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Inspection">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Inspector" name="Inspector">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterMachineType</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterSerialNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnswerQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PressButton</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_InspectionCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Application" name="Inspection Application">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EstablishMachineConnection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectMachineValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShowCollectedValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inspection" name="Inspection started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToEnterType</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineType" name="Enter machine type">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToEnterType</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterTypeToEnterSerial</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSerialNumber" name="Enter serial number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterTypeToEnterSerial</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterSerialToEstablishConnection</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_EstablishMachineConnection" name="Establish connection to machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterSerialToEstablishConnection</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EstablishConnectionToAnswerQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerQuestions" name="Answer questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EstablishConnectionToAnswerQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AnswerQuestionsToPressButton</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressButton" name="Press button">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AnswerQuestionsToPressButton</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PressButtonToCollectValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectMachineValues" name="Collect values from machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PressButtonToCollectValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectValuesToShowValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowCollectedValues" name="Show collected values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectValuesToShowValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShowValuesToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" name="Additional questions required?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShowValuesToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsRequired</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" name="Answer additional questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsRequired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin" name="Merge after additional questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted" name="Inspection completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToEnterType" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inspection" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterTypeToEnterSerial" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineType" targetRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterSerialToEstablishConnection" sourceRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber" targetRef="Task_EstablishMachineConnection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EstablishConnectionToAnswerQuestions" sourceRef="Task_EstablishMachineConnection" targetRef="Task_AnswerQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AnswerQuestionsToPressButton" sourceRef="Task_AnswerQuestions" targetRef="Task_PressButton"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PressButtonToCollectValues" sourceRef="Task_PressButton" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectValuesToShowValues" sourceRef="Task_CollectMachineValues" targetRef="Task_ShowCollectedValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShowValuesToSplit" sourceRef="Task_ShowCollectedValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsRequired" name="Results require additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" targetRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsToJoin" sourceRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
